messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high 5xx rate for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 — severity: P2. Details: 5xx spike starting ~3012345600, user impact ~12% errors. Paging primary oncall. link: https://pager.redwood.internal/inc/3012345678
Alex K: ack — i'm primary for this shift. jumping in. any initial clues?
Samir R: support here — got a couple customer reports, some mention requests timing out then 5xx. I can share a curl example.
Samir R: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -v```
Alex K: thanks. first quick check: rolling avg latency up and error rate by instance group. looking at runtime metrics now.
Maria G: i'm secondary, available to take any infra escalations. if we need capacity changes or node reboots i can coordinate.
Jaya L: runtime team — i'm on standby. likely suspects: KV cache evictions or a recent kernel change in the optimized runtime. pulling logs from sequence cache.
Infra Oncall: infra here — we saw a minor autoscaler glitch in eu-west last night but it reported healthy this morning. i can check GPU node health and network partitions.
Alex K: ok let's triage: 1) scope (all tenants or subset) 2) reproduce 3) whether fallback to smaller model works. Samir, can you paste a customer request id?
Samir R: customer IDs: cust_42 and cust_77. both show 502 from gateway. attaching truncated trace id: trace-0x9a3f
Jaya L: grabbing logs for trace-0x9a3f. initial look: model shard responded with OOM on host gpu-uw-17 -> returned 502 upstack.
Alex K: OOM on gpu-uw-17. ok. is that an isolated host or whole pool? Infra?
Infra Oncall: checking pool: gpu-uw pool has 12 nodes, one node (gpu-uw-17) showing elevated memory usage and oom events. can't see widespread network errors. looks isolated.
Maria G: if it's isolated OOM we should route to runtime to evict offending model + possibly route traffic off the node. Jaya, can runtime trigger model unload on that host or do we need infra intervention?
Jaya L: runtime can attempt graceful eviction of model shards on that host. i can run the unload command: ```/usr/local/bin/runtimectl unload-shard --host=gpu-uw-17 --shard=shard-22``` but we should cordon the node in infra while we do it to avoid immediate rescheduling.
Infra Oncall: i'll cordon gpu-uw-17 and mark for drain: ```kubectl cordon gpu-uw-17 && kubectl drain gpu-uw-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data``` will move pods away. doing it now.
Infra Oncall: cordon+drain started. ETA ~45s for pods to reschedule.
Alex K: good. Maria, can you watch user-facing errors and decide on severity escalation if consumer impact rises? Samir, can you message affected customers with a short note? use template: "We're investigating elevated errors for generation requests in eu-west; engineers are actively mitigating; no action required on your side."
Samir R: will do, sending to cust_42 and cust_77 now.
Oncall Bot: system: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-5xx-eu-west — follow step 3c for OOM host recovery.
Maria G: quick note on routing: if the evicted model doesn't come back healthy, we should fallback to the quantized model variant to reduce memory. runtime team — can we enable auto-fallback policy for this pool?
Jaya L: we have a fallback route but it's a config toggle: ```routing.enable_fallback(eu-west,pool=gpu)``` — i can flip it but prefer to do it after node is drained and we confirm degraded capacity. want to avoid unnecessary model switches.
Alex K: agreed. continue with cordon/drain; post-drain, check model shard placement and KV cache warmup impact. if traffic still sees >8% errors for 5 minutes, escalate to P1.
Infra Oncall: drain completed, pods rescheduled to gpu-uw-05/09/11. node gpu-uw-17 is drained and cordoned.
Jaya L: runtime attempted shard unload; unload logs show success for shard-22 but eviction delayed due to large KV snapshot. forced unload completed.
Alex K: monitoring metrics — error rate dropping to baseline ~1.5% now, latency recovering. good sign. Maria, close loop with support on customer comms?
Maria G: i'll follow up with Samir and confirm customers notified. also note coverage gap: i'm off shift in ~35m and next primary is @Alex K (stays on) but we have no security oncall signed for rotation tonight — Security Pager, can you confirm coverage for this window?
Security Pager: security oncall here — currently oncall hands are assigned to @sec-anna but she's OOO today. i can take low-level FYIs, but require escalation if we suspect data exfil or auth issues. this incident looks runtime memory OOM so not security.
Alex K: noted. also logging for postmortem: please add timeline to incident ticket and note 'root cause: OOM on gpu-uw-17 due to large cached KV snapshot + uneven shard placement'. follow actions: (a) add automated cordon on repeated OOM, (b) enable fallback route threshold at 10% error for pool, (c) review autoscaler leak for last night's event.
Jaya L: i'll open runtime PR for safe-unload ordering to avoid long KV snapshot delays.
Infra Oncall: i'll file infra ticket to add node-level memory alert at 80% and to investigate autoscaler anomaly.
Samir R: customers updated with status "mitigated, monitoring". no additional churn reported.
Maria G: ok, i'm handing off primary to Alex (stays), i'm going offline in 35m — leaving runbook pointers in the ticket. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Alex K: thanks Maria. runtime+infra, please sync with me on-boarding notes for the next rotation. I'll update the incident ticket and mark resolved once 60m stable.
Oncall Bot: incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. incident ticket: INC-3012345678
